extendedinputbox-desc: Adds advanced dialog-based forms on top of InputBox
extendedinputbox-error-unresolved-title: The generated page title still contains unresolved braces: $1. Check the "page=" parameter of the <inputbox> configuration.
extendedinputbox-error-preload-fetch: Could not retrieve the preload template "$1". The page was not published. Check that this template exists and try again.
extendedinputbox-error-popup-preload-dep: Error: the "popup-preload" parameter is no longer supported. Please use "preload" instead.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bgcolor: Error: the value of "button-bgcolor" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bordercol: Error: the value of "button-border-color" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-duplicate-field: Error: the field name "$1" is used more than once in this form.
extendedinputbox-special-intro: Visually build an <inputbox> form, then insert the generated wikitext into a target page, preview it and publish it.
extendedinputbox-special-field-skipedit: Publish directly, without the edit screen (skip-edit=yes)
extendedinputbox-special-no-fields: No fields yet. Click "Add a field" to start.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-newpage: This page does not exist yet. It will be created when you publish.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-inserted: Wikicode inserted at the cursor position.
extendedinputbox-special-error-notitle: Please enter a valid page title.
extendedinputbox-special-error-noedit: You do not have the necessary rights to edit this page.
extendedinputbox-special-error-noedit-de: You do not have the necessary rights to edit this page: $1
extendedinputbox-special-error-editconfl: An edit conflict was detected: the page was edited by someone else since it was loaded. Click "Load page" again, then reapply your changes before publishing.
extendedinputbox-special-error-copy-fail: Copy failed. Please select the text manually.
extendedinputbox-special-warning-incompl: Field #$1 has no name and/or label: it will not be included in the generated wikitext.
extendedinputbox-special-error-noinsert: Please load a target page first.
extendedinputbox-special-confirm-overwri: This page already exists. Do you want to overwrite it with your changes?
extendedinputbox-special-preview-popup-b: Preview — this reproduces the popup's appearance as currently configured; nothing will be published from this window.
extendedinputbox-special-warning-pipe-in: Field #$1 contains the "|" character, which is the segment separator: it will corrupt the generated wikitext.
extendedinputbox-error-page-exists: The page "$1" already exists and was not modified.
extendedinputbox-confirm-skipedit: This will publish the page "$1" directly, without showing the edit screen. Continue?
extendedinputbox-error-skipedit-forbidde: Direct publication to "$1" is not allowed (interface, script, style and JSON pages are excluded).
